denominatorPolicy: Retain all generated/defensive production branches. No exclusions or reflective private calls. XML reports missed branch counts per source line, not true/false labels.

sourceLevelDominance.arm: Null fallback of orEmpty in private migration steps
sourceLevelDominance.reason: migrateToCurrent normalizes every collection before the first private step. Every subsequent bump normalizes again; all step copies preserve non-null lists. Public JSON null-collection parsing is exercised; it cannot pass a null list into these private steps.

sourceLevelDominance.arm: Blank transaction sync status inside migrateV8ToV9
sourceLevelDominance.reason: normalizeTransaction replaces blank syncStatus with SYNCED before any private migration step; intervening steps do not make it blank.

sourceLevelDominance.arm: Unsupported version else in private migrateOneStep
sourceLevelDominance.reason: Public version guard accepts1..22; the loop calls the step only for1..21, all explicitly handled. No concurrent mutation of immutable payload is supported.

limits: These narrow source-level observations do not establish that all other missing branches, Kotlin data-class defaults or Compose paths are unreachable.
